Bluehair Scene candidate remains visibly red-blocked and renders at 1280x720; the authored root identity is still absent from the product catalog. Visual intent remains unresolved.
Filename view counts are not treated as pose counts. The receipt lists current root/Scene candidate identities; loose parts are excluded from complete-character and pose counts.
